admission.justification: Whole-subject browser review answers held by their existing bounded comparison-generation cache. Losing this boundary would fabricate currentness, attribute another owner's work, hide an external change, or repeat an unsafe host/landing action rather than exposing the actual observation.

applicability: Whole-subject browser review answers held by their existing bounded comparison-generation cache.
conditions: Each answer carries its own complete display data.
exclusions: No second read to reconstruct a retained answer; unrelated caches keep their own owners.

evidence: MIK-R81@v1 rule7; preserved cold/warm native response parity

statement: A subject answer repeats its complete display data so a browser can show any of its twenty-four retained answers without a second request.
